breakpoints.note: The parser has already accepted a key and `=` and is now pulling the value through `lex_next()`. On the witnessed path that call reaches `lex_config()` and selects `lex_multiline_string()` for an opening `"""` value.
First project-side consumption of the copied fuzz buffer and its clipped length: the fuzz-only helper materializes the logical parser span as `len - 1` bytes of attacker-controlled data.

Missing bounds check before the 3-byte terminator probe. The vulnerable loop calls `strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)` without first proving that at least three bytes remain before `lexer->end`; the fix inserts `if (remaining(lexer) < 3) break;` immediately before this line.
